title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Rate and Availability Sheet
content:
**Cascade Ortho Rider family — Orthodontic Benefit Riders.** Six riders are offered. Each is attached to one person's Cascade Dental PPO enrollment and is available only with the dental plans, in the markets and up to the application age shown for it below. The monthly premium is charged per covered person.

## Availability by rider

| Rider | Dental PPO plans it can be attached to | Markets | Highest age at application |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | Classic 1250, Plus 1500 | individual, group | 18 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | Classic 1250, Plus 1500, Premier 2000 | individual, group | 18 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | Plus 1500, Premier 2000, Elite 2500 | individual, group | 18 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | Plus 1500, Premier 2000 | individual, group | 0 (no application age limit) |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | Premier 2000, Elite 2500 | group | 0 (no application age limit) |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | Elite 2500 | group | 0 (no application age limit) |

The dental plan names are the Cascade Dental PPO plan names (for example, Classic 1250 is Cascade Dental PPO Classic 1250).

## Premium, market and enrollment terms

| Rider | Monthly premium per covered person (USD) | Sold with group enrollments only | Minimum employees enrolled in the group's dental plan | Re-enrollment lockout after a voluntary termination (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Child 1000 | 9.85 | no | 2 | 12 |
| Child 1500 | 13.40 | no | 2 | 12 |
| Child 2000 | 17.15 | no | 5 | 12 |
| Family 1500 | 12.60 | no | 10 | 24 |
| Family 2000 | 16.75 | yes | 10 | 24 |
| Family 3000 | 24.90 | yes | 25 | 24 |

Terms that are the same on every rider:

- **Occasions for adding a rider:** only together with a new dental enrollment, or effective on the attached enrollment's benefit-period start.
- **Cascade DHMO enrollment:** on every rider, the rider cannot be held by a person who has an applied or active Cascade DHMO enrollment, because the DHMO orthodontic copay schedule applies instead.

## Notes on reading the sheet

- The premium shown is the individual-market rider rate per covered person per month. Group rates are set by each group contract.
- A group may offer a rider only if at least the number of employees shown are enrolled in its dental plan. The Family 2000 and Family 3000 riders are sold only with group enrollments.
- The lockout runs in calendar months from the termination date of a rider that the subscriber ended voluntarily. During the lockout the same person may not add a rider again.

*Hypothetical reading:* a group with 7 employees enrolled in its dental plan meets the minimum for Child 1000 and Child 1500 (2) and for Child 2000 (5). It does not meet the minimum of 10 for Family 1500 or Family 2000.
